title: Add uncomplete schedule task endpoint
acceptanceCriteria: A new endpoint exists (e.g. `DELETE /api/schedule/:id/complete`) that sets `is_completed = false` and `completed_at = null`
The endpoint is documented in `lib/api-spec/openapi.yaml` with operationId `uncompleteScheduleTask`
Codegen runs clean: `pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run codegen` produces a `useUncompleteScheduleTask` hook
The Done badge in `schedule-dnd.tsx` toggles back to Pending when clicked, calling the new hook
`pnpm run typecheck` passes with zero new errors
